questions.question: Correct the anachronistic phrase “Archimedes’ method of indivisibles”: Kepler used his own infinitesimal reasoning inspired by ancient solid geometry, while the systematic method of indivisibles is associated with Cavalieri’s later work.

localizations.source: Correct the anachronistic phrase “Archimedes’ method of indivisibles”: Kepler used his own infinitesimal reasoning inspired by ancient solid geometry, while the systematic method of indivisibles is associated with Cavalieri’s later work.
localizations.ru: Исправить анахронизм «метод неделимых Архимеда»: Кеплер использовал собственные инфинитезимальные рассуждения, вдохновлённые античной стереометрией; систематический метод неделимых связан с более поздней работой Кавальери.

questions.resolution: The anachronism was removed: the wording distinguishes Kepler’s infinitesimal reasoning from Cavalieri’s later systematic method.
